milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the dark_oak_slabs placed on the ground at approximately (0, 0, 3) and (1, 0, 4) spawn-relative and face toward them. The target is set to (0, 0, 3) — one of the two ground-level slabs directly in the player's forward path. max_distance=16 allows detection from spawn (only ~3-4 blocks away), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the slabs rather than away from them.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a dark_oak_fence_gate results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with 2 dark_oak_planks and 4 sticks (the exact recipe for 1 dark_oak_fence_gate) and must use the crafting table inside the building at (3,0,11) to craft it. The crafted item ends up in inventory, and the player does NOT start with any dark_oak_fence_gate, making inventory_has the most direct and reliable check.
